page.about.title: About Us
page.about.p1: CodeLab Developer is an all-in-one web developer toolkit built by Genius Digital for web developers, programmers, designers, IT students and general users.
page.about.p2: All core tools run fully inside your browser: no VPS, no API keys and no subscriptions. Your code is processed on your own device.
page.about.p3: The platform is available in Bahasa Melayu, English and العربية, with full right-to-left (RTL) layout support.
page.about.hp1: Driving Digital Innovation Through Smart, Creative and Efficient Systems.
page.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
page.privacy.p1: We respect your privacy. CodeLab Developer is designed so that your data stays on your device.
page.privacy.hp1: Text, code and files you enter into the tools are processed entirely in your browser. They are not sent to our servers or to any third party. Generated passwords are never stored.
page.privacy.hp2: We use localStorage to remember your personal preferences: language, favorite tools, tool history, saved color palettes and sidebar state. This data stays on your device and can be deleted through your browser settings.
page.privacy.hp3: This site uses no advertising cookies. Scripts and fonts are self-hosted; the only external connection is to Google Firestore for aggregate statistics counters.
page.privacy.hp4: We record aggregate visit counts (daily, monthly and total) in Firebase Firestore under the Genius Digital project. Only counter numbers are stored, with no personal data, IP addresses or user IDs; a visit is counted once per day per browser.
page.terms.title: Terms of Use
page.terms.p1: By using CodeLab Developer you agree to the following terms.
page.terms.hp1: The tools are provided free of charge for lawful use. You are responsible for the content you process and for how you use the results.
page.terms.hp2: The tools are provided “as is”. We strive for accuracy, but please review results before using them in production. The HTML Validator is a basic structural check, not a W3C validator, and the JWT Decoder does not verify token signatures.
page.terms.hp3: The CodeLab Developer brand, design and code are owned by Genius Digital. Open-source libraries used remain subject to their respective licenses.
page.contact.title: Contact Us
page.contact.p1: For enquiries, suggestions for new tools or problem reports, contact the Genius Digital team through the channels below.
page.contact.empty: Contact details have not been set by the administrator yet. Please update js/config.js.
page.guide.title: User Guide
page.guide.p1: Get started in a few simple steps. Every tool works inside your browser.
guide.s1.d: Use the search box above or pick a category in the sidebar. You can search by name, category or function.
guide.s2.d: Paste code or text, open a file, or press Sample to try it out. Results update automatically.
guide.s3.d: Use the Copy or Download buttons on the result panel. Generators also offer a ZIP download.
guide.s4.d: Tap the heart icon to bookmark a tool. Favorites and history are stored in your browser only.
guide.a1: Yes. Every tool is free and needs no account, API key or subscription.
guide.q2: Is my code sent to a server?
guide.a2: No. All processing happens inside your browser.
guide.q3: Why are visitor statistics shown as “—”?
guide.a3: The database is not connected yet. We do not display fake numbers. Global statistics will go live once Firebase is connected.
guide.q4: How do I change the language?
guide.a4: Use the BM / EN / AR buttons in the top corner. Your choice is remembered after a page refresh.
guide.q5: Does the JWT Decoder verify tokens?
guide.a5: No. It only decodes and displays the token contents. Signature verification must be done on your server.

adm.banner.title: UI preview mode only
adm.banner.text: The database and Firebase Authentication are not connected yet, so this page is NOT protected and holds no real data. Do not place sensitive data here. Once connected, admin access is verified by Firebase Authentication + an admin role custom claim + Security Rules on the server — not by the frontend.
adm.index.p1: The Admin Panel is separate from the public panel. It manages the platform's tools, statistics, users, settings and content.
adm.index.p2: Sign-in uses Firebase Authentication. Admin data access is verified by Security Rules on the server.
adm.index.f1: Routes separate from the public panel (/admin/…)
adm.index.f3: Admin data access is enforced by server Security Rules
adm.index.f4: Security Rules block access even if the URL is changed
adm.login.note: Authentication is handled by Firebase Authentication. Passwords are never stored or written in this site's code.
adm.login.step1: Create a Firebase project and enable Authentication (email/password) plus MFA.
adm.login.step2: Set the admin: true custom claim through the Firebase Admin SDK (trusted script/Cloud Function).
adm.login.step4: Fill in firebase/firebase-config.js and replace NullAuth with FirebaseAuthProvider.
adm.login.step5: Test: a regular account must be rejected by the Security Rules even when it opens the /admin URL.
adm.dash.localNote: Shows usage in this browser only (not global statistics). Global data becomes available once Firebase is connected.
adm.dash.noActivity: No activity recorded. Logs will come from the Firestore “activity” collection.
adm.tools.draftNote: The switches here are a draft in this browser only and do NOT affect the public panel until saved to the database (config/tools).
adm.stats.noChart: No chart data. The chart will be drawn from stats_daily once the database is connected.
adm.users.name: Name
adm.users.empty: No user data. The list will come from Firebase Authentication/Firestore.
adm.users.note: User management (suspend, roles) must be performed through the Firebase Admin SDK/Cloud Functions on the server, not directly from the browser.
adm.set.note: Settings here are not saved to a database yet. You can export the configuration as JSON.
adm.set.name: Platform name
adm.set.brandLocked: The Genius Digital brand name cannot be changed.
adm.set.errLogo: The logo must be a valid http(s) URL or file path.
adm.set.errDefaultLang: The default language must be among the allowed languages.
adm.content.note: Text is loaded from the current translation files. Edits here are not saved to a database yet; use Export JSON.
adm.denied.title: Access denied
adm.denied.text: This account is valid but has no admin permission for CodeLab Developer. The server (Security Rules) rejects admin data access. Sign out and use an admin account.
adm.tools.liveNote: The switches here are saved to the database (codelab_config/tools) and immediately hide tools from the public panel after you press Save.
adm.saveFailed: Save failed. The server rejected it or the connection dropped.
adm.set.noteLive: Settings are saved to the database (codelab_config/site). You can also export them as JSON.
adm.content.noteLive: Original text is loaded from the translation files; edits are saved to codelab_content. Showing edited text on the public panel is not enabled yet; use Export JSON to update the locale files.
adm.login.errMany: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
adm.login.why1: Sign-in through Firebase Authentication, not a password in code.
adm.login.why2: Every admin data read/write is checked by Security Rules on the server.
adm.login.why3: Changing the URL or unhiding a button grants no data access.
adm.login.sub: Sign in to manage tools, statistics and content.
